svg.title: V3 GraphRAG architecture
svg.desc: Offline index reused from V1, then an online pipeline with data-driven entity detection, optional meaning split, rerank, embedding section choice, few-shot answer call, code verification and code-based abstention.
svg.text: Name words filtered; aliases from label text
Exact, fuzzy, longest-name span rule, alias cap 2
Named drug found: drug mode; else symptom mode
One LLM call, 2-3 phrases; k-means as fallback
Label-hash dedupe, pool 15, pass 8 across groups
Embedding similarity: 5 core + top 3, no LLM
Group then drug quota, 4,500 tokens, auto-shrink
Word overlap >= 0.8, else YES/NO; flag only
Code: no chunks, or answer has only Gap lines
FLAGS: alias, rerank, split (llm/cluster/none), few_shot, shot4, verify
